ruleDefinitions.name: New DNS ServerLevelPluginDll Installed Via Dnscmd.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the installation of a DNS plugin DLL via ServerLevelPluginDll parameter in registry, which can be used to execute code in context of the DNS server (restart required)

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\dnscmd\\\.exe$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/config.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/serverlevelplugindll.*")))
